```artifact
Feature: Doorstop Requirements Functional Test Suite

  Scenario: Doorstop provides unique and permanent identifiers to linkable sections of text
    Given a document with multiple linkable sections
    When a unique identifier is assigned to each section
    Then each section can be referenced uniquely and permanently

  Scenario: Doorstop supports formatting within linkable text
    Given a linkable text section
    When formatting options (e.g., bold, italic, underline) are applied
    Then the formatting is preserved when the section is referenced

  Scenario: Doorstop supports the storage of external requirements assets
    Given an external requirements asset (e.g., PDF, Word document)
    When the asset is uploaded to Doorstop
    Then the asset is stored and accessible within the system

  Scenario: Doorstop can import content from other requirements management tools
    Given content from a supported requirements management tool
    When the content is imported into Doorstop
    Then the content is accurately represented within Doorstop

  Scenario: Doorstop can export content to interact with common text/document tools
    Given a set of requirements within Doorstop
    When the content is exported to a common format (e.g., Markdown, HTML)
    Then the exported content is compatible with external text/document tools

  Scenario: Doorstop provides a way to view requirements as a document
    Given a collection of requirements
    When the requirements are viewed as a document
    Then the output is a formatted document reflecting the requirements hierarchy

  Scenario: Doorstop provides a way to view document items interactively
    Given a document with multiple items
    When an item is selected interactively
    Then detailed information about the selected item is displayed

  Scenario: Doorstop provides the capability to baseline versions of requirements
    Given a set of requirements
    When a baseline version is created
    Then the baseline captures the current state of the requirements for future reference

  Scenario Outline: Validate identifier uniqueness and permanence
    Given a document with <num_sections> linkable sections
    When identifiers are assigned
    Then each identifier is unique and remains unchanged across sessions

    Examples:
      | num_sections | expected_result |
      | 1            | identifiers are unique |
      | 10           | identifiers are unique |
      | 100          | identifiers are unique |
      | 0            | no identifiers are assigned (edge case) |

  Scenario Outline: Validate formatting preservation within linkable text
    Given a linkable text section with <formatting_option>
    When the section is referenced
    Then the formatting is preserved

    Examples:
      | formatting_option | expected_result |
      | bold              | formatting is preserved |
      | italic            | formatting is preserved |
      | underline         | formatting is preserved |
      | none              | no formatting applied (edge case) |

  Scenario Outline: Validate import and export functionality
    Given content in <source_format>
    When the content is <imported_exported>
    Then the content is accurately represented in <target_format>

    Examples:
      | source_format | imported_exported | target_format | expected_result |
      | Markdown      | imported          | HTML          | content is accurate |
      | HTML          | exported          | Markdown      | content is accurate |
      | Word          | imported          | PDF           | content is accurate |
      | PDF           | exported          | Word          | content is accurate |
      | unsupported   | imported          | any           | import fails (invalid path) |
      | any           | exported          | unsupported   | export fails (invalid path) |
```
